name: The Forest of Fractured Time
source:
Two adorable little girls, Lux and Umbra, took a wrong turn, and now they're on the other side of a thick, snowy forest--and it's almost dinner time!

Gently guide the quirky youngsters through the very odd Forest of Fractured Time in this light and extremely short visual novel.

[From [url=https://pyrrhaiphis.itch.io/the-forest-of-fractured-time]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个可爱的小女孩拉克丝和安布拉拐错了路，现在她们来到了一片厚厚的白雪森林的另一边——而且快到晚饭时间了！

在这部轻松而极短的视觉小说中，温柔地引导古怪的年轻人穿过非常奇怪的破碎时间森林。

[来自[url=https://pyrrhaiphis.itch.io/the-forest-of-fractured-time]Itch.io[/url]]
